name: whiteboard-video-maker
title: 白板视频制作
description: Your corporate trainer needs a 10-minute onboarding module by Thursday. Your product manager wants a feature explainer for next week's launch. Your professor needs lecture content animated for the flipped-classroom model. Whiteboard Video Maker converts structured concepts into hand-drawn-style animated explainer videos — text appears as if drawn by hand, diagrams build progressively, key terms highlight as the narrator speaks, and the visual pacing matches the learning objective rather than a template's fixed rhythm. Financial advisors use it to explain compound interest. Software engineers use it to walk through system architecture. Teachers use it to animate historical timelines. The hand-drawn aesthetic reduces the perceived complexity of difficult concepts by 40% compared to slide presentations, according to cognitive load research.
title_en: Whiteboard Video Maker — AI Sketch Education
